d:
aarti jay santoshi mata | Aarti Jai Santoshi Mata | Anuradha Paudwal
jay santoshi mata! jay man santoshi!
Mata santoshi ki madhur aarti **jay santoshi mata, maiya jay santoshi mata** sunkar man ke shricharnon men apni shraddha aur bhakti arpit karen. suprasiddh gayika anuradha paudval ji ki madhur aavaz men man santoshi ki yah bhaktimay aarti man ko shanti pradan karti hai aur bhakton ko man ki bhakti se jorti hai.
Shukravar ke shubh din man santoshi ki puja-archana karen, aarti gaen aur apne parivar ki sukh-shanti, samriddhi evan khushhali ke lie man se prarthana karen.
